Whether the instance holds a pair, whatever the capitals of the username

round_present.Rd

REDCap compares usernames without regard to case: its tables use a _ci collation, so the module's state read asked about Mario.Rossi@ answers with the row it stores, mario.rossi@, and the person is on the project under either. round_actual() matches the names as written, and asked "is the person still there" it would answer no on a difference of capitals alone: a revocation settled on that answer leaves the person on the project, with the row closed and nobody told.

Usage

round_present(results, request)

Arguments

results

The results of a state reply.

request

One request, carrying username and project_id.

Value

TRUE when results holds the pair in any case.
